decision_table.if: not prohibited AND no Art. 53(1) purpose fits

53.title: Purposes for secondary use
53.one_liner: Health data may be used only for listed purposes such as research, public health, policy, official statistics, teaching and better care.

purposes.a: public or occupational health (public bodies only)
purposes.d: education and teaching in health or care
purposes.e: scientific research incl. product development and algorithm training

54.title: Prohibited secondary use
54.one_liner: Some uses are banned: decisions against people, insurance and employment decisions, advertising, harmful products.

61.title: Duties of health data users
61.one_liner: Users must not re-identify people or share data with third parties.

66.title: Data minimisation and purpose limitation
66.one_liner: Only the data needed are given, anonymised by default, pseudonymised only if anonymised data cannot work.

67.title: Health data access applications
67.one_liner: What an application for access to data must contain.

68.title: Data permit
68.one_liner: When a data permit is issued, and what it contains.

69.title: Health data request
69.one_liner: A health data request is answered only with anonymised statistics.

71.title: Right to opt out
71.one_liner: People can opt out; their data are then not used.

73.title: Secure processing environment
73.one_liner: Permitted data are accessed only in a secure processing environment; records cannot be downloaded.
